serviceDescription:
Judges a proposed payment against a registered spend policy and returns allow, block or escalate, with the rule that decided it.
policyId(string, required): The id of a policy registered on the PolicyRegistry contract, as a decimal string; provider(string, required): The provider you want to pay, by its registered id.; capability(string, required): What you want that provider to do, by its registered capability id.; task(string, required): What this payment is for, in a sentence a person would recognise.; maxSpend(string, required): The most you will spend, in DISPLAY units — "20.00", not base units.; currency(string, required): The settlement currency's symbol; deadline(string, required): After this the request is stale and must be rebuilt rather than replayed.; recipient(string, optional): Optional; parameters(object, optional): Optional; acceptance(object, optional): Optional; idempotencyKey(string, optional): Optional; buyerAgentId(string, optional): Optional and temporary; workerAgentId(string, optional): Optional and temporary
POST
curl -X POST https://asp.untch.xyz/preflight_payment -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"policyId\":\"7\",\"provider\":\"stabledomains\",\"capability\":\"domains.register\",\"task\":\"Register kyrve.xyz for one year\",\"maxSpend\":\"20.00\",\"currency\":\"USDT0\",\"deadline\":\"2026-08-02T12:00:00.000Z\",\"recipient\":\"0xd9ed4d474b0d01031d10d637546450f39ed6a5ba\",\"parameters\":{\"domain\":\"kyrve.xyz\",\"years\":1},\"buyerAgentId\":\"6047\",\"workerAgentId\":\"6086\"}"

Checks a delivered result against the acceptance criteria that were committed to before the work started, and records the verdict.
intentId(string, required): The intent to verify, as returned when it was created.; expectedResultHash(string, optional): Optional
POST
curl -X POST https://asp.untch.xyz/verify_delivery -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"intentId\":\"0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111\"}"

Says whether this exact task, endpoint and parameter set was already paid for recently.
policyId(string, required): The id of a policy registered on the PolicyRegistry contract, as a decimal string; taskHash(string, required): The task hash to look for.; endpoint(string, required): The endpoint the prior call would have used.; paramsHash(string, required): The parameter hash to look for.
POST
curl -X POST https://asp.untch.xyz/detect_duplicate -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"policyId\":\"7\",\"taskHash\":\"0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111\",\"endpoint\":\"https://asp.untch.xyz/ping_untch\",\"paramsHash\":\"0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555\"}"

Strips emails, phone numbers, API keys and bearer tokens out of payment metadata and hashes what is left.
metadata(object, required): The metadata to strip.
POST
curl -X POST https://asp.untch.xyz/redact_payment_metadata -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"metadata\":{\"note\":\"ship to ada@example.com\",\"orderId\":\"A-1\"}}"

Proposes short product names for an idea, filtered against a list of over-used startup stems.
idea(string, required): What the product does, in a sentence.; count(number, optional): How many names to return
POST
curl -X POST https://asp.untch.xyz/builder/suggest_names -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"idea\":\"spend control for autonomous agents\",\"count\":6}"

Runs naming, domain checking, ranking and the launch checklist as one call.
idea(string, required): What the product does, in a sentence.
POST
curl -X POST https://asp.untch.xyz/builder/brand_pack -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"idea\":\"spend control for autonomous agents\"}"
